ANGELITE Perfume Description

ANGELITE is a bold and sophisticated fragrance that seamlessly blends fruity freshness with smoky, woody undertones, creating a timeless and powerful allure. Opening with vibrant bursts of sunlit fruits, it transitions into a heart rich with depth and intrigue before settling into a warm, velvety base. This scent is crafted for those who exude confidence and seek elegance that lingers long after they've gone.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top Notes:
    • Pineapple – Sweet, juicy, and tropical, offering a bright, refreshing start.
    • Bergamot – Citrusy and uplifting, adding a zesty, sunlit sparkle.
    • Blackcurrant – Tart and fruity, enhancing the top with a vibrant twist.
    • Apple – Crisp and fresh, evoking an orchard's radiance.
  • Middle Notes:
    • Birch – Smoky and bold, introducing an intriguing woody essence.
    • Patchouli – Earthy and deep, grounding the fragrance with a refined richness.
    • Rose – Soft and romantic, adding a floral elegance.
    • Jasmine – Lush and luminous, enhancing the heart with subtle sensuality.
  • Base Notes:
    • Oakmoss – Earthy and green, evoking a timeless, classic appeal.
    • Ambergris – Warm and slightly marine, adding depth and subtle mystery.
    • Musk – Soft and sensual, leaving a lingering, elegant trail.
    • Vanilla – Sweet and creamy, rounding off the scent with comforting warmth.

ANGELITE captures the essence of bold elegance, transitioning effortlessly from day to night. It’s a fragrance for those who appreciate complexity, power, and sophistication, leaving an unforgettable impression.

8497139974318.title: BLACK STALLION
8497139974318.description:
Black Stallion:
Black Stallion, an adventurous and bold men’s fragrance that captures the essence of power and elegance in every note. This woody spicy scent takes you through a captivating journey, layer by layer:

  • Top Note: Bergamot
    Bright and refreshing, the first spray greets you with the zesty and slightly bitter touch of bergamot. This citrus note adds a fresh and uplifting start, creating an energizing sensation that sets a vibrant tone.
  • Middle Note: Juniper and Black Pepper
    As the fragrance unfolds, the sharp, aromatic bite of juniper blends with the warmth of black pepper. Together, they create a spicy, invigorating heart that commands attention and adds complexity to the composition, evoking a sense of rugged confidence and vitality.
  • Base Note: Atlas Cedar, Virginian Cedar, and Himalayan Cedar
    The fragrance lingers with a strong, masculine base of three distinctive cedar woods. The Atlas cedar brings a smooth, creamy warmth, while Virginian cedar adds a dry, smoky edge. The Himalayan cedar rounds out the base with its earthy, slightly resinous character, leaving a lasting impression of strength, resilience, and elegance.

Ideal for the man who thrives on adventure and exudes quiet confidence, Black Stallion is a signature scent that makes a statement without saying a word.

 

Type: Men’s Fragrance

 

Size : 50ml, 1.7 fI. oz.

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

9063555465390.description:
Candyfloss is a sweet and carefree fragrance that feels like a golden summer breeze on sun-warmed skin. The scent begins with a playful burst of tropical fruit and sweetness that instantly feels bright and nostalgic. It then moves into a tropical floral heart that adds a layer of exotic, creamy elegance.

The fragrance concludes with a fluffy vanilla and sandalwood base, creating a cozy, sun-drenched finish full of beach-day memories.

Notes:

  • Top Notes: Coconut water and Bergamot create a playful, refreshing opening.
  • Middle Notes: Tiare flower and Jasmine form a tropical, floral heart that brings warmth and grace.
  • Base Notes: Vanilla and soft musk provide a creamy, fluffy base that lingers with golden warmth.

Type: Women Fragrance

Size: 150ml

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

8765015490734.title: CHARM POUR FEMME
8765015490734.description:
Charm:
Charm pour Femme is an enchanting floral fragrance that captivates the senses and embodies elegance.

  • Top Note: Orange Blossom, Jasmine
    The scent opens with a bright and uplifting blend of orange blossom and jasmine, evoking a sense of freshness and femininity.
  • Heart Note: Bulgarian Rose, Orris, Lily of the Valley
    In the heart, the luxurious Bulgarian rose intertwines with soft orris and delicate lily of the valley, creating a lush bouquet that envelops you in floral richness.
  • Base Note: Tuberose, Ylang Ylang, Sandalwood, Musk
    The fragrance settles into a warm and creamy base of tuberose, exotic ylang ylang, rich sandalwood, and subtle musk, adding depth and sensuality.

Charm pour Femme is perfect for the woman who radiates grace and allure, leaving a trail of sophistication wherever she goes.

 

Type: Women’s Fragrance

Size : 100ml, Eau De Parfum

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

SHIPPING NOTE:
Fragrances cannot be shipped internationally as it’s restricted by DHL courier due to its flammable nature. delivering only in Pakistan

8639684804782.description:
EMERALD Perfume Description

EMERALD captures the spirit of the outdoors, offering a vibrant and refreshing escape into nature. This fragrance opens with a burst of crisp, fruity freshness, transitions into a heart of aromatic herbs and florals, and settles into a warm, woody base. It embodies a natural allure, perfect for those who seek vitality and a connection to the outdoors.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top Notes:
    • Bergamot – Bright, citrusy, and crisp, evoking the freshness of a cool breeze.
    • Kiwi – Juicy, tropical, and vibrant, adding a playful, fruity twist.
  • Middle Notes:
    • Rosemary – Herbal, aromatic, and invigorating, bringing a sense of clarity and energy.
    • Geranium – Fresh, green, and slightly floral, balancing the scent with a natural elegance.
  • Base Notes:
    • Cedarwood – Warm, woody, and grounding, providing depth and sophistication.
    • Oakmoss – Earthy and green, adding a crisp, natural finish reminiscent of forest trails

EMERALD is a refreshing and uplifting fragrance, ideal for those who embrace life with energy, vibrance, and a love for the outdoors. Its natural and crisp profile makes it the perfect companion for any moment of renewal and inspiration

Type: Men’s Fragrance

Size : 100ml, 3.4 FL . OZ

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

8642750283950.description:
Faras Valley
Faras Valley captures the essence of a day's journey from dawn's radiant light to dusk's serene elegance. This enchanting fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of citrus and spices that invigorate the senses, transitions into a warm, smoky heart that exudes sophistication, and concludes with a deep, grounding base that leaves a timeless impression of refined allure.


Notes:
•    Top Notes: The sweet warmth of davana combines with the zesty brightness of bergamot and the subtle spice of pink pepper, creating an uplifting and radiant introduction.
•    Middle Notes: A creamy blend of amber meets the earthy freshness of rosemary and the smoky allure of oud, forming a rich, sophisticated core.
•    Base Notes: A sensual harmony of soft musk, supple leather, and earthy vetiver lingers on the skin, embodying elegance and depth.

Type: Unisex Fragrance 

Size : 100ml, Eau De Parfum

8742122946734.title: FLORIS
8742122946734.description:
Floris:
Floris is a captivating kids' fragrance that dances with the delightful charm of floral sweetness and warm amber.

  • Top Note: Almond, Coffee, Peach
    It opens with a playful blend of almond, coffee, and peach, creating a sweet and nutty aroma that feels like a cozy morning treat, inviting curiosity and joy.
  • Middle Note: Jasmine, Tuberose, Tonka
    The heart reveals a beautiful bouquet of jasmine and tuberose, enriched with tonka, enveloping your little one in a floral dream that sparks creativity and imagination.
  • Base Note: Cocoa, Vanilla, Sandalwood
    Finally, it settles into a warm embrace of cocoa, vanilla, and sandalwood, wrapping them in a comforting and soothing scent that lingers gently throughout the day.

Floris is the perfect fragrance for young dreamers, celebrating the joy of childhood with every delightful spritz.

 

Type: Kids Fragrance 

Size : 30ml, Eau De Parfum

8497148100782.title: HORIZON
8497148100782.description:
Horizon:
Horizon, a captivating men's fragrance that embodies the spirit of adventure and the allure of the unknown. This woody spicy scent is crafted to take you on a journey through bold, invigorating notes that reflect strength, confidence, and refinement.

  • Top Note: Orange, Grapefruit
    The scent opens with a burst of citrus freshness. The vibrant orange brings a juicy, sweet undertone, while the grapefruit adds a tangy, slightly bitter edge. Together, they create an uplifting and energizing introduction that sets a dynamic tone.
  • Middle Note: Pepper, Pelargonium, Flint
    As the fragrance deepens, the warm, spicy kick of pepper takes center stage, igniting a sense of strength and passion. Pelargonium adds a subtle floral-green nuance, softening the spice with a refreshing touch. Flint contributes an earthy, mineral aspect, evoking a rugged, masculine charm that adds depth and character.
  • Base Note: Vetiver, Cedar, Patchouli
    The scent lingers with a strong, grounding base. Vetiver brings an earthy, smoky richness, while cedar adds a dry, woody warmth. Patchouli completes the composition with its deep, musky sweetness, leaving a lasting impression of raw, masculine sophistication.

Horizon is the perfect fragrance for the man who is always pushing boundaries, embracing new challenges, and seeking new heights. Its rich, layered notes create an aura of confidence and adventure that stays with you all day.

 

Type: Men’s Fragrance

Size : 50ml, 1.7 fI. oz.

Mehraab:
Mehraab is an oriental fragrance that exudes elegance and warmth.

  • Top Note: Red Berries, Peach, Bergamot
    It opens with a juicy burst of red berries and peach, balanced by the zesty brightness of bergamot, creating an inviting freshness.
  • Heart Note: Jasmine, Red Lily, Peony
    The heart blooms with the soft floral notes of jasmine, red lily, and peony, bringing a delicate yet captivating richness.
  • Base Note: Vanilla Flower, Sandalwood, Musk
    The base lingers with the creamy sweetness of vanilla flower, smooth sandalwood, and sensual musk for a lasting, sophisticated warmth.

Mehraab is a bold yet refined scent, perfect for the modern man.

Type: Men’s Fragrance

Size: 100ml, Eau De Parfum

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

9045082046638.title: MEWA MOUTH FRESHNER
9045082046638.description:
A Decadent Medley of Nuts, Dates, and Delicate Sweetness

MTJ Naturals Meva Mouth Freshener is a lavish blend crafted for those who enjoy a richer, dessert-like finish after meals. This premium mukhwas combines aromatic fennel seeds with naturally sweet dry dates, crunchy almonds, coconut, and jewel-like sweet elements, delicately enhanced with vanilla coco and chocolate coconut notes. Every spoonful delivers layers of flavor—nutty, mildly sweet, and indulgently aromatic—creating an experience that feels celebratory rather than routine. Designed as much for refined gifting as for personal enjoyment, Meva Mukhwas brings together tradition and indulgence in a truly luxurious form.

MTJ Naturals Mughlai Mouth Freshener is a rich and indulgent mukhwas inspired by the grandeur of Mughal cuisine, where layers of taste and texture defined every course. Crafted for those who appreciate heritage flavors with a premium touch, Mughlai Mukhwas is ideal for refined daily use as well as elegant hospitality and gifting.

Musk Beard Oil

Refined Care for Beard and Hair

Upgrade your daily grooming routine with MTJ Musk Beard Oil, a premium argan oil-based formula created to help soften, smooth and add a healthy-looking shine to your beard.

Key Benefits

  • Helps soften dry and rough beard hair
  • Adds a healthy-looking shine
  • Helps improve smoothness and manageability
  • Leaves behind a refined musk fragrance
  • Suitable for beard and hair
  • Ideal for everyday grooming

Moroccan Argan Oil Care

Formulated with Moroccan Argan Oil, this grooming essential helps care for dry, damaged and thin-looking beard or hair while improving its overall appearance and texture.

How to Use

Take a small amount of oil onto your palm and rub your hands together. Apply evenly through a clean, dry or slightly damp beard, then massage gently into the beard and skin. Finish by combing or shaping as desired. For hair, apply a small amount to the lengths and ends for added shine and smoothness. Avoid using excessive product.

Best For

  • Dry or rough beards
  • Dull and difficult-to-manage beard hair
  • Men who prefer a neat and polished look
  • Daily, office, Jummah and occasion grooming
  • Beard and hair care routines

  • Key Ingredient: Moroccan Argan Oil
  • Size: 60 ml
  • Suitable For: Men

9045081948334.title: NAWABI MOUTH FRESHNER
9045081948334.description:
A Regal Finish to Every Meal

MTJ Naturals Nawabi Mouth Freshener is a distinguished mukhwas inspired by royal dining traditions, where taste, aroma, and presentation mattered equally. This elegant blend of fennel seeds, sesame seeds, coriander splits, and betel nuts is delicately sweetened and finished with a hint of menthol for a clean, cooling aftertaste. The result is a well-rounded mouth freshener with layered textures—crunchy, nutty, and aromatic—that refreshes the palate while offering a satisfying post-meal ritual. Crafted for those who appreciate tradition with a premium touch, Nawabi Mukhwas is ideal for both daily enjoyment and graceful hospitality.

9063553532078.title: NEENA
9063553532078.description:
Neena is an elegant and intimate fragrance that blends soft fruits with deep, sensual musk. The scent begins with a velvet light of peach and citrus that feels instantly inviting. It then moves into a signature musky heart that adds a layer of creamy, floral intensity.

The fragrance concludes with a dark vanilla and vetiver base, creating an intimate finish that is both sophisticated and quietly addictive.

Notes:

  • Top Notes: Peach and Bergamot create a juicy, bright opening with a velvety texture.
  • Middle Notes: White Flowers and Musc Heart form a creamy, floral core that brings harmony and depth.
  • Base Notes: Vanilla and Vetiver provide a warm, earthy base that lingers with dark sensuality.

Type: Women Fragrance

Size: 150ml

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

15406803091630.description:
Oceanica:
Oceanica is a distinguished men’s fragrance that beautifully combines the essence of the sea with the warmth of amber, creating a captivating experience for the modern man.

  • Top Note: Orange Blossom
    It opens with the bright aroma of orange blossom, evoking the freshness of a sun-drenched beach and awakening your senses.
  • Middle Note: Amber
    The heart reveals a rich embrace of amber, adding depth and a luxurious, resinous quality that envelops you in warmth and comfort.
  • Base Note: Woody Notes
    It settles into grounding woody notes, providing a solid foundation that complements the sweetness of amber and the freshness of orange blossom, enhancing the fragrance's longevity.

Oceanica is more than just a scent; it’s a journey through the elements, ideal for day or evening wear. Embrace the spirit of the ocean and let Oceanica become your signature scent.

Welcome to the world of MTJ Fragrances, where every scent is a story waiting to be told and every fragrance is a journey of sensory delight. With a rich heritage in crafting exceptional perfumes, MTJ Fragrances is a name synonymous with elegance, luxury, and the art of olfactory expression.

MTJ Oud E Sultan is a fragrance that carries the essence of power, sophistication, and mystique. Its story unfolded in a mesmerising blend of notes, where the intoxicating aromas of Absinth and Anis mingled at the top, followed by a blossoming heart of Jasmine, Violet, and Cistus Spain, and anchored by a captivating base of Tobacco, Praline, Vanilla, Saffron, Amber, Cedarwood Alaska, and Vetiver Java. MTJ Oud E Sultan is a masterpiece that command-ed attention, captivating all who crossed its path with its enchanting blend of notes, and its presence evoked the regality of a true Sultan of scents.

MTJ Bishaar, inspired by the ecstatic feeling of receiving good news. An enveloping and addictive fragrance. Rich with emotion and encased in powdery, creamy warmth, it echoes a comforting embrace full of inner gratitude. Turkish rose and warm saffron dance joyfully around one another as they open the fragrance. The heart beats of diffusive white flowers lacquered in balsamic vanilla - teasing the senses. Rich Labdanum and refined patchouli undertones enhance the hypnotic oud, creating a symphony of passionate joy.

MTJ Oud E Yousuf, a rich aromatic oriental fragrance which effortlessly exemplifies burning fierceness and charisma. A gentleman's presence alongside his dame - protective, spontaneous, and alluring. Fresh aromatic lavender blends with bright zests of bergamot opening the fragrance. Charming patchouli and sound Labdanum awaken deep cypriol in the heart, recalling the "chivalrous" acts of one in love. In the background, powerful oud - a noble pillar - is enveloped in airy amber with hints of green oakmoss.

MTJ Oud E Azeem, tells the story of the brave and audacious legacy of a royal king. A woody oriental fragrance that evokes the stable, powerful nature of an established and flourishing kingdom. Intense smoky incense and its smoldering grip on sharp saffron and cardamom adds new dimensions - evoking a powerful aura. The Cypriot is unleashed - enhancing the exotic woodiness of sandalwood while imbuing it with vetiver undertones - for an unforgettable silage. Rich patchouli finally dominates the scene, while ambery cashmere provides a sense of success and victory.

MTJ Oud E Afraz, symbolizes a power play of sheer sophistication. A spicy oriental fragrance which brings to mind lavish dinners in the city's grandest high rises. Saffron, the star of the night opens the fragrance alongside strong ginger notes - recalling smart, sharp attire worn at opening theatres. While swaying in sandalwood undertones, the classic red rose sings in harmony with the powerful clove leaf. Opulent patchouli leads the orchestra with hints of mellow honey, elegantly wrapped in musk and amber.

7580240019630.title: QALAM
7580240019630.description:
Qalam:
Qalam, a captivating men’s fragrance that embodies sophistication and strength through its woody spicy composition.

  • Top Note: Bergamot, Pepper
    The scent opens with a bright burst of bergamot, awakening the senses with its zesty freshness. This invigorating citrus is harmoniously blended with the warmth of black pepper, delivering an enticing kick that ignites intrigue.
  • Heart Note: Patchouli, Jasmine
    At its core, Qalam reveals a rich heart of patchouli and jasmine. The earthy depth of patchouli exudes confidence, while jasmine adds a soft, floral elegance, creating a balanced allure that speaks to the complexity of modern masculinity.
  • Base Note: Musk, Amber
    The fragrance settles into a warm, sensual base of musk and amber. Musk wraps you in intimacy, while amber provides a rich, resinous warmth, leaving a memorable and inviting trail.

With Qalam, each note unfolds like a story, inviting you to express your individuality and allure. Perfect for any occasion, it’s a signature scent that captivates and empowers.

Type: Men’s Fragrance

Size: 100ml, Eau De Parfum

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

MTJ Naturals Rajasthani Mouth Freshener draws inspiration from the robust and flavorful culinary traditions of Rajasthan. This thoughtfully balanced mukhwas blends aromatic fennel seeds with coriander splits, dry dates, and betel nuts, lightly sweetened and finished with a cooling hint of menthol. Crafted with care and tradition, this blend delivers a satisfying crunch and long-lasting freshness, making it ideal for everyday enjoyment as well as premium hospitality.

9080887935150.description:
Santal Glow is a clean and atmospheric fragrance that feels like walking through a sunlit wooden room. The scent begins with a warm and airy opening of spice and soft florals that feels immediately calming. It then moves into a creamy sandalwood heart that adds a layer of smooth, quiet mystery.

The fragrance concludes with a dry cedarwood and amber base, creating a lingering, woody trail that is both sophisticated and addictive.

Notes:

  • Top Notes: Cardamom and airy violet create a fresh, spicy opening with a light floral touch.
  • Middle Notes: Creamy sandalwood and soft iris form a smooth, velvet heart that brings balance and refinement.
  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, musk, and warm amber provide a deep, earthy base that settles with a cozy finish.

9040998367406.title: SEA SPICE
9040998367406.description:
Sea Spice:
Sea Spice is a captivating men’s fragrance that merges the invigorating essence of the ocean with aromatic spices. Designed for the adventurous modern man, this aromatic fougère scent offers both freshness and depth.

  • Top Note: Calabrian Bergamot, Pepper
    It opens with zesty Calabrian bergamot and a hint of pepper, delivering a bright, energizing introduction that captures the essence of a sea breeze.
  • Middle Note: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Patchouli, Geranium, Elemi
    The heart reveals a complex blend of spices and florals, featuring bold Sichuan pepper and calming lavender. Pink pepper adds warmth, while earthy vetiver and patchouli enhance its depth, finished with floral geranium and resinous elemi for a dynamic and multifaceted experience.
  • Base Note: Ambroxan, Cedar, Labdanum
    It settles into a warm base of smooth Ambroxan and rich cedar, providing a sturdy foundation. Labdanum adds a resinous warmth, enhancing the fragrance’s sophistication and longevity.

Sea Spice is more than just a fragrance; it captures the essence of nature's elements, empowering the wearer with confidence and a sense of adventure. Embrace exploration and sophistication with Sea Spice, an essential addition to any modern man’s collection.

 

Type: Men’s Fragrance

Size : 50ml, 1.7 fI. oz.

8639676219566.description:
WHITE BOUQUET Perfume Description

WHITE BOUQUET is a captivating fragrance that merges jasmine’s radiant floral elegance with almond’s velvety touch, creating an aura of seductive charm. Designed for those who carry themselves with poise and grace, this scent weaves a symphony of subtle power and irresistible allure. It opens with a luminous sweetness, blooms into a hypnotic floral heart, and settles into a soft, sensual embrace that lingers beautifully in the air.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top Notes:
    • Creamy Almond – Velvety and smooth, adding a delicate sweetness and comforting warmth.
  • Middle Notes:
    • White Floral Jasmine – Radiant and elegant, bringing a fresh yet sensual floral heart.
    • Hedione – Light and airy, amplifying the florals with a subtle, sparkling freshness.
  • Base Notes:
    • Soft Musk – Warm and sensual, leaving a lingering trail of subtle allure.

WHITE BOUQUET is perfect for those who embrace their magnetic presence, exuding charm and elegance with every step. It’s a fragrance that speaks of quiet sophistication and lasting impression.

Type: Women’s Fragrance

Size : 100ml, 3.4 FL . OZ

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

  • Base Note: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk

Wood Intense is for the man who seeks a bold, fresh, and timeless scent.

8746223698094.title: ZIRAN
8746223698094.description:
Ziran:
Ziran is a captivating kids' fragrance that beautifully balances playful freshness with comforting warmth.

  • Top Note: Bergamot, Lavandin, Sage
    It opens with a bright burst of bergamot, blended with the calming essence of lavandin and the herbal notes of sage, creating an invigorating and cheerful introduction.
  • Middle Note: Pimento, Cedarwood
    The heart reveals a unique mix of spicy pimento and soothing cedarwood, adding a touch of adventure while maintaining a sense of grounding.
  • Base Note: Patchouli, Leathery, Musk
    Finally, it settles into a warm base of patchouli, subtle leather, and soft musk, wrapping your child in a cozy, protective embrace.

Ziran is the perfect companion for curious little explorers, inspiring joy and confidence with every spritz.

 

Type: Kids Fragrance 

Size : 30ml, Eau De Parfum

Application Tips:
For an enhanced fragrance routine
Apply this scent onto pulse points .i.e. Behind ears, on wrists, and on the neck

SHIPPING NOTE:
Fragrances cannot be shipped internationally as it’s restricted by DHL courier due to its flammable nature. delivering only in Pakistan
